summary: The Marzetti Company filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $200 million term loan to partially fund its $400 million acquisition of Bachan's, Inc., a Japanese barbecue sauce brand, with the balance from cash on hand. The term loan, drawn on April 29, 2026, matures April 29, 2031, with a springing maturity date of March 6, 2029 under certain conditions; quarterly principal payments of $2.5 million begin after the first full calendar quarter. The acquisition closed on the same date. Watch for integration updates and margin impact; no arb angle as deal is cash and closed.
